name: Gondarfolas
backstory: A seafarer normally based in Görff, travelling all around the continent. Owns a small ship he uses to take travellers from coast to coast. An avid reader of history, well versed in the history of Milkantis. Has a knack for exaggerating some things. Per the Luminacion Register, also based in Terfila on the return leg of the ferry run ("Sailing to Gorff") - the same sailor working both directions, per the register's own matched pair.

experience: Owns a small ship and regularly runs a route past Catraniz and Sit Nalta.
Has an old copy of the Ensayo (era nine) and a copy of the Libro, and knows the two chronicles don't reconcile with each other (CONFLICT-01).

Bought his history books years ago from a trader in Görff he recalls as 'Bracco, or Braggo' - a big, heavily scarred man who sold them off cheaply and asked no questions; Gondarfolas has no idea where the man came from or went.
Has never been to Khol Moshin - as a sailor, he only goes where there's coastline.

Heard (via a traveler, unconfirmed) that Därnis's siblings are organizing a search expedition, departing from where a highway ends at the continent's southern tip - new information to him, not something he can confirm.

routines.routine_actions: trades in eras and quarrels between the Ensayo and the Libro he owns, exaggerates just enough to be asked back
runs the return ferry leg, first ashore with whatever a traveler picked up in Görff
barters passage and small cargo along the coastal route, an old book trader's habits still on him
